claims.statement: Makefile.toml defines repository-wide checks while stable Rust is the active compiler channel.
macOS packaging uses xcode-select unless DEVELOPER_DIR is explicitly supplied and verifies signed payload and native ABI contracts.
scripts/macos/test_native_app.sh builds the locked stable Rust native client library and supplies its debug path only to Swift test fixtures; product loading remains bundle-owned.

The prepare-codex task explicitly reuses, repairs, builds or imports the pinned development component, while pin-codex verifies an official Release and writes a separate requirement after checking the current development baseline.

Application staging embeds the selected runtime requirement and Sparkle without Codex binaries or schemas; release staging requires an official Release requirement that covers the current baseline, and staging does not install the app.

The discard-empty Agent CLI command sends an exact local work identity through the service; its transaction refuses roots, native bindings, active or scheduled work, children, history, dependencies and saved prompt input, and treats an already absent ID as complete.

The opt-in native archive qualification uses an explicit Codex binary, a temporary native home, a loopback Responses fixture and 10,300 unrelated archive records to verify two archive and unarchive cycles across retained processes without restarting or starting extra model turns.

Retained native qualification uses the portable evidence index, explicit selected CLI/helpers and actual test registration; ignored native fixtures must be selected explicitly and zero or missing selectors are not execution evidence.

Reusable native artifact probes accept explicit binary, source commit and output environment, use synthetic loopback providers and system-temporary homes, and clean up their child processes and servers.

Hook qualification checks actual script effects after trust, content, enablement and restart changes; parallel tool qualification requires concurrent outstanding requests and ordered results; MCP qualification waits for discovery before comparing opaque metadata across paging and restart.

The original source-cohort record retains its dev-small helper recipe and registered identities; the current qualification identifies the selected artifact and affected native checks. Nextest source helpers do not establish execution of the signed production CLI.
The Project Work full-suite LEAK belongs to the appearance fade test and has no established cause; later qualification receipts do not establish that historical marker's cause.
Development staging honors an explicit DECODEX_RUNTIME_LOCK_PATH requirement without compiling Codex, while release staging retains the development-baseline check.

Reproducible Project Work qualification commands distinguish preparation, exact-artifact native tests and overlapping local cohorts; historical audio failures and later passing media and workspace reruns stay separate from installed-app or live-account acceptance.

The native Project and nested Work follow-up executes seven selected native tests with zero unmatched selectors, 189 database tests, four runtime guards and a schema57/90-table gate; the final complete workspace run passes 2921 with 1157 skipped and no LEAK while retaining its separate first failed run.

The two unchanged UI frame samples passed ten isolated executions of the same artifact and now reserve Nextest runner resources with assertions and default selection retained; the first follow-up resume-test LEAK remains unexplained.

The source-built lifecycle acceptance retains a reusable two-Project/four-Work scenario and separate actual bundle/native identities; its final 2924-test workspace run, nine native tests, 13-package lint and schema59 checks remain separate from the later control follow-up, which verifies live Pause/Resume and Full Access with explicit encrypted-proof and official-UI limits.

The selected control cohort requires DECODEX_TEST_CODEX_BINARY and DECODEX_NATIVE_BINARY to point to the same verified prepared CLI; three native permission tests and one database hold test passed after correcting a missing environment variable and an outdated global-reviewer fixture.

The separate installed development qualification records 1025 passed UI tests with complete-run cleanup markers and three passing isolated controls, twelve exact-artifact native regressions, strict lint for 13 packages and formatting; it does not reuse the earlier 2924-test workspace receipt as a fresh UI-repair run.

Online voice acceptance uses an explicit isolated-root marker, a single idle fixture Agent and locally generated PCM; two opt-in tests qualify final dictation without task submission and live decoded speech followed by Ended, with separate hardware and installed-UI limits.

The selected read-only views qualification passed 2998 workspace tests, two exact-artifact native tests, four selected UI tests, 28 Python tests, strict Clippy for five packages, formatting and the schema59/90-table gate; the full vstyle audit failed with 16517 findings, and installed-app or real-provider acceptance was not performed.

The portable native fixture runner uses one short system-temporary HOME per invocation, preserves host tool locations, prepares the selected component under a separate native home and cleans the fixture afterward. Every Recap service mode uses the owned checkout under actual OS-account working-directory authority while product directory checks stay active.

The stable attached-fork catalog preserves the original native, backend, UI, workspace and repository-check results with overlapping-cohort, synthetic-provider and cleanup limits. The retired startup-configuration diagnostic creates no current regression obligation. Current qualification separately identifies the selected CLI and affected executions.

The exact-artifact command hook probe checks nested command cwd in PreToolUse, PermissionRequest and PostToolUse payloads while the hook process keeps the project cwd; its synthetic local command does not qualify a remote executor.

Reusable exact-artifact probes check missing or directory .env startup, saved permission recovery despite stale turn context in both history modes, and distinct persisted policy-capacity errors without a Decodex automatic retry.

The explicit test-native-voice task requires macOS and an existing DECODEX_APP_SIGN_IDENTITY, builds the locked GPUI test target, signs a separate serialized test copy with a fixed identifier, verifies four exact non-ignored selectors and executes them through supported Nextest build reuse without changing Cargo's original artifact or general test commands.

The automation test task runs Node checkpoint behavior regressions before the existing portfolio tests; automation-control changes use affected checks rather than an app, provider or broad upstream suite.

Full macOS workspace validation can run the ordinary suite with the exact four transport names excluded, then run those same four through the signed task; the signed task rejects missing or ignored selected tests.

The explicit official-archive test validates both macOS WebRTC ZIP digests and strict headers, while the retained trust-anchor probe checks retired and control certificate DER bytes in each selected static library.

Historical workspace dependency qualification keeps source and artifact identities, executed tests, residual constraints and the original style failure separate from current CLI qualification and installed-app acceptance.

The opt-in original EGM validation uses a verified native executable, a private evidence directory and process-scoped subscription authentication for a first review, separate approved repair, second fresh review and explicit halt; it retains artifacts and native events and consumes model quota.
Retained named-permission fixtures set an explicit read-only default before selecting a scoped profile, preserving their original permission, directory and restart assertions.
The current contract catalog excludes the explicitly retired startup-configuration diagnostic while preserving the original execution evidence and its limits.

The provider-recovery runner verifies an explicit candidate and matching lock, starts the real desktop against a temporary public-socket service with synthetic providers, and cleans the temporary profile when the window exits without changing the normal runtime selection.

Retained disabled-input and direct-Fork regressions cover layout, contained actions, source preparation, durable intent, recovery and related draft/connection states. Input-bar Fork has no second confirmation or Cancel control. The stable retained_provider_recovery catalog preserves the source symbols, regressions and original qualification limits; historical local checks do not qualify a new native artifact.

The provider rehearsal uses the named destination in the feedback band above the composer and one Fork click to create and open without sending. It has no second confirmation, retains a temporary profile and does not install the app or change runtime selection or schedules.

The CLI initializes an idle Assistant without a message, selects the Assistant role and sends typed commands through the existing service. Components manages RAGFlow nightly and Infinity without model weights. A saved Models summary offers Edit; its four fields share one OpenAI-compatible Base URL and optional API key across extraction and embedding model IDs. Save verifies both choices before Memory initialization. New Memory connections enable automatic learning; saved choices survive updates. Fixtures and installed deployment evidence have distinct boundaries.

The completion-mail probe uses the exact qualified CLI and packaged helpers to check unsampled FINAL_ANSWER retention, ordering and ordinary-inference acknowledgement through repeated manual compaction and cold continuation in four legacy/paginated and local/remote combinations. It does not qualify ordinary agent-message retention or mid-turn preemption.
Assistant configuration stores only a private component credential reference bound to the RAGFlow origin; it does not select credentials through a service environment variable.

The historical provider-refusal desktop rehearsal requires a native artifact that emits modelProviderMismatch after a changed default; current saved-provider continuation and fork qualification are separate exact-CLI checks.

The explicit development reset has plan and apply modes, rejects a running local service, reads before native deletion with a 60-second offline request bound, stops on unrecognized errors, resets managed Memory and clears local conversation and execution data through the database owner. It preserves account and model configuration, project folders and quota-reset receipts, removes drafts, blobs, cache, backups and logs, and submits no native inference turn.

The ignored exact-artifact development component fixture verifies that ordinary ensure rejects damaged CLI, schema and helper files, then explicitly reinstalls the verified local package while retaining other versions. This fixture does not install or launch the desktop app.

The CLI saves or cancels an existing Agent's independent duty through schedule and cancel-schedule, using typed AgentWake JSON and exact idempotency keys. The Agent status exposes scheduled_wakes separately from the personal Assistant settings.

Focused database and runtime fixtures cover independent duty cadence and receipt recovery, owner isolation, archive cancellation and native automation input with separate application-tool context. These fixture results do not establish installed scheduled execution.

Before a development source build, version preparation normalizes the extracted workspace's Rust channel to stable, preserves its component list and rejects external dependency-graph changes. The repository source-preparation test checks the channel and preserved components.
